label: weather_query
text: Mbula ekobanda na ngonga nini lelo?
english_meaning: What time will the rain start today?

label: weather_query
text: Lobi na butu malili ekozala?
english_meaning: Will it be cold tomorrow night?

label: weather_query
text: Mopepe ekopela makasi na mpokwa?
english_meaning: Will the wind blow strongly in the evening?

label: weather_query
text: Na mikolo oyo, moyi ekobima mingi?
english_meaning: Will it be very sunny in the coming days?

label: datetime_query
text: Lobi ekozala mokolo ya boni?
english_meaning: What day will tomorrow be?

label: datetime_query
text: Sanza oyo ezali na mikolo boni?
english_meaning: How many days are in this month?

label: datetime_query
text: Tokokoma na sanza ya sika mokolo nini?
english_meaning: On what day will we enter the new month?

label: datetime_query
text: Sikoyo tozali na ngonga ya boni?
english_meaning: What time is it now?

label: alarm_set
text: Tya alarme na ngonga ya libwa ya butu.
english_meaning: Set an alarm for 9 p.m.

label: alarm_set
text: Tya ngai alarme mpo na kolamuka na ngonga ya minei ya tongo.
english_meaning: Set an alarm to wake me up at 4 a.m.

label: alarm_set
text: Alarme na ngai ebeta lisusu sima ya miniti zomi.
english_meaning: Make my alarm ring again after ten minutes.

label: alarm_set
text: Bomba alarme mpo na mokolo ya lomingo na ngonga ya sambo.
english_meaning: Set an alarm for Sunday at 7.

label: calendar_set
text: Koma rendez-vous na ngai ya mokolo ya mibale na calendrier.
english_meaning: Add my Monday appointment to the calendar.

label: calendar_set
text: Tya likita na ngai ya mosala na calendrier mpo na lobi.
english_meaning: Put my work meeting on the calendar for tomorrow.

label: calendar_set
text: Koma rendez-vous na monganga na ngonga ya misato na calendrier.
english_meaning: Add my doctor's appointment at 3 to the calendar.

label: calendar_set
text: Tya mokolo ya mbotama ya mama na calendrier mpo na mokolo ya zomi na mitano.
english_meaning: Add Mum's birthday to the calendar for the 15th.

label: calendar_set
text: Koma likita ya libota na calendrier na ngai mpo na poso oyo ezali koya.
english_meaning: Add the family meeting to my calendar for next week.

label: calendar_query
text: Nazali na rendez-vous mokolo ya lomingo?
english_meaning: Do I have an appointment on Sunday?

label: calendar_query
text: Na sanza oyo, nazali na makita boni?
english_meaning: How many meetings do I have this month?

label: calendar_query
text: Rendez-vous na ngai ya nsima ekozala mokolo nini?
english_meaning: What day is my next appointment?

label: calendar_query
text: Lelo nazali na likita na ngonga nini?
english_meaning: What time is my meeting today?

label: calendar_query
text: Na poso ekoya, nazali na rendez-vous nini?
english_meaning: What appointments do I have next week?

label: lists_createoradd
text: Sala liste ya biloko ya kosala na ndako.
english_meaning: Create a list of things to do at home.

label: lists_createoradd
text: Bakisa sukali na liste ya biloko ya kosomba.
english_meaning: Add sugar to the shopping list.

label: lists_createoradd
text: Koma bankombo ya ba films oyo nalingi kotala na liste.
english_meaning: Write the names of films I want to watch on a list.

label: lists_createoradd
text: Sala liste ya biloko oyo nasengeli komema na mobembo.
english_meaning: Create a list of things I need to take on a trip.

label: lists_createoradd
text: Bakisa kombo ya monganga na liste ya bato ya kobenga.
english_meaning: Add the doctor's name to the contact list.

label: lists_query
text: Lakisa ngai liste ya biloko ya kosala na ndako.
english_meaning: Show me the list of things to do at home.

label: lists_query
text: Nasengeli kosomba biloko nini lisusu?
english_meaning: What else do I need to buy?

label: lists_query
text: Bankombo nini ezali na liste ya bato ya kobenga?
english_meaning: Which names are on the contact list?

label: lists_query
text: Liste ya biloko ya mobembo ezali wapi?
english_meaning: Where is the travel items list?

label: lists_query
text: Nakomaki ba films nini na liste ya oyo nalingi kotala?
english_meaning: Which films did I write on my watchlist?

label: play_music
text: Tya miziki ya Koffi Olomide.
english_meaning: Play Koffi Olomide's music.

label: play_music
text: Tya ngai miziki ya rumba ya Kinshasa.
english_meaning: Play Kinshasa rumba music for me.

label: play_music
text: Nakolinga koyoka miziki ya kimia.
english_meaning: I would like to listen to relaxing music.

label: play_music
text: Tya loyembo ya Fally Ipupa oyo eyebani mingi.
english_meaning: Play a popular song by Fally Ipupa.

label: play_music
text: Tika miziki ekoba kobeta.
english_meaning: Let the music keep playing.

label: news_query
text: Sango nini ya sika ezali na mokili?
english_meaning: What is the latest news around the world?

label: news_query
text: Nini ezali koleka na Kinshasa lelo?
english_meaning: What is happening in Kinshasa today?

label: news_query
text: Pesa ngai sango ya sika ya masano.
english_meaning: Give me the latest sports news.

label: news_query
text: Sango nini ya sika ezali na makambo ya politiki?
english_meaning: What is the latest political news?

label: news_query
text: Nini ya sika ezali koleka na mboka na biso?
english_meaning: What is happening in our country?

english_meaning: What does general knowledge mean?

english_meaning: What is the internet and how does it work?

english_meaning: What is the difference between a computer and a phone?
